scores.notes: Hezekiah stands centred with a staff in the temple court, priests and Levites at the altar and bronze sea behind; carved cherub reliefs only, no glyphs, and the pale top edge is painted hazy sky.
Alice sits indignant in an armchair at the near end while the March Hare and Hatter crowd the far corner over the sleeping Dormouse; no lettering on the hat or china, edges fully painted.
Fire and sulfur streak down onto two burning walled cities across the plain with glowing pits and a small herder shielding his face at lower centre; no figure in the sky, no glyphs or blank edges.
Aged Adam lies still on a mat in the tent with bowed family members on either side at dusk; the hearth is lit rather than cold, a minor detail, and nothing malformed or lettered.
Jesus stands in the boat with arm extended over smoothing water while soaked disciples cling to the sides under a lightening sky; the shape by the sail at right is a rope knot, not a hand.
Naomi sits central with the infant in her lap, the women of Bethlehem in an arc around her in a lamplit mudbrick courtyard; edges are fully painted and no glyphs.
Daniel stands calm in the stone den among crouched closed-mouthed lions, Darius leans over the rim at top left and two guards hold torches at top right; nothing lettered or malformed.
Holmes has a recognisable Benedict Cumberbatch screen likeness; the cane is stuck in the ventilator at upper left with nobody holding it while Holmes holds only the match.
Saul kneels shielding his eyes under a shaft of light on the road with companions shielding theirs and Damascus beyond (anachronistic dome and minaret); white paper margins all round are accepted.

Holmes, standing at back left with a lit lantern, has a Benedict Cumberbatch screen likeness; the others stand in plain view rather than hidden in darkness, and small white paper shows at the top-left and bottom-right corners (accepted).

The seraphim are ordinary two-winged angels with bare feet showing, not six-winged with faces and feet covered by wings, and the top-centre one holds tongs and a coal from a later verse; the cloud has no figure, though a small golden statue-like shape stands in the sanctuary doorway.

Kneeling Holmes with lens and lantern has a Benedict Cumberbatch screen likeness; a faint script-like squiggle sits on a floor flag at lower centre-right, and the bottom corners fade to paper (accepted).
Holmes and Watson resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman, and a book on the desk at centre-right has pseudo-letters on its cover; the left edge is white paper (accepted).

Holmes, holding the blue stone up at the window, has a Benedict Cumberbatch likeness and the seated Watson resembles Martin Freeman; the open strongbox at left is full of more blue gems, which works against a single unique stone.
Five disciples bail and grip the sides of a swamped boat in high waves under storm clouds, with other boats and the shore beyond; a white paper patch at the bottom-left edge is accepted.

A 'K' index shows on the card courtier at right and the papers on the reading stand carry script lines; the Knave (red doublet, crown cushion) and the helmeted soldiers along the right wall are drawn as humans, not flat cards.

Peter stands in the foreground by a brazier glancing across the courtyard to Jesus in red in the middle distance, with a rooster on the roof at top right and servants by the fire; the net Peter carries is an odd prop but nothing faulty.
Disciples stand on the shore by the beached boat and net, looking at a charcoal fire with fish and a loaf on it, village houses behind; the bright top edge is painted sky, no glyphs.
A golden radiance rises over dark misty water from the upper centre with no figure or form in it; the edges are dark painted canvas with no white or lettering.
Moses stands centre with staff, arm outstretched, while families pack bundles and animals below a cloud-wrapped mountain; no lettering or malformed figures.
A priest beside the horned altar plucks a bird so feathers fall onto the ash heap, with the tabernacle and a few onlookers behind; white paper margins are accepted.
Holmes, standing at right, has a Benedict Cumberbatch screen likeness beside the bandaged Hatherley pointing at the burning house; small white paper bits at the left corners are accepted.
The father embraces his ragged barefoot son while two servants approach from the left with a robe and sandals, though no ring is visible; the pale top edge is accepted.
Attendants lift Daniel out over the den's rim while Darius leans in joyfully from the left, with lions resting below; the barred gate inside the pit is odd, but the scene, hands and edges are fine.
Holmes and Watson have Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman likenesses, and the newspaper at right has headline-like letters while the letters on the desk carry script lines.

Playing cards on the walls and the card courtier at left show corner indices ('K', 'A'); otherwise the nervous Hatter with teacup and bread, the King on the dais, the spectacled Queen and the slate-holding jury match the scene.
